items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: And then when he sent for Janet, Janet came.

ctx.x: Yeah. And he used to play that number by my Joelis Feeze. And then when he sent for Janet, Janet came. And then I played with pops up there. We always were friends, you know. Come down to the Chinese house, his mother, and she cooked and all that. And then the next thing I was playing, I was playing from one band to another. And the nights when I wasn't on the boat playing, I would maybe play some bill guard and somebody else would get me to play piano.
Did you ever play on another boat beside the Madison?
